## 二、跟进话术模板

### 首次开发信（英文）

```
Subject: Marvell-Based L3 Managed Switches — 50-70% Below MikroTik/Zyxel Pricing

Dear [Name],

I noticed [Company] distributes networking equipment in [Region], including 
managed switches from brands like MikroTik and Ubiquiti.

We are SmartByte Technology, a Shenzhen-based manufacturer specializing in 
Marvell chipset managed switches — Layer 3 (RIP/OSPF/BGP4/ECMP/VRRP) and 
Layer 2+ with 10G SFP+ uplinks.

Quick comparison vs. MikroTik CRS328-24P-4S+:
• MikroTik CRS328: ~$500 retail
• SmartByte equivalent (24×GE PoE + 4×10G SFP+): ~$140 FOB (¥1,010)
• Same Marvell enterprise chipset, full BGP/OSPF routing
• CE/FCC/UKCA certified, ISO 9001/14001 factory

We offer:
✓ OEM/ODM with your branding
✓ SKD/CKD for local assembly
✓ MOQ from 10 units for samples
✓ 8000 sqm factory, 500+ models in catalog

Would you be interested in a sample evaluation? I can send our full product 
catalog and pricing list.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
SmartByte Technology
peter@smartbyte.com.cn | +86-137-1429-3521
```

### 跟进邮件（1周后）

```
Subject: Re: SmartByte L3 Managed Switches — Sample Available

Hi [Name],

Following up on my previous email. I wanted to share a specific use case:

One of our partners in [similar market] was reselling MikroTik CRS326-24G-2S+ 
at ~$200/unit. After switching to our STC-424XGGM:
• Their cost dropped to ~$100/unit (FOB)
• Same 24×GE + 4×10G SFP+ configuration
• Added full DHCP server + IPv4/IPv6 static routing
• Margin improved from 15% to 50%

Would you like to test 2-3 sample units? We can ship via DHL within 3 days.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
```

### 3.3 OEM/D2C品牌合作

**目标客户**: MokerLink, Sodola, 以及Amazon上所有销售10G管理型交换机的新兴品牌

**合作模式**:
1. 白牌贴标 — 客户品牌+SmartByte制造
2. 定制固件 — 根据客户需求定制Web管理界面
3. 定制包装 — 客户设计包装+说明书
4. SKD/CKD — 支持散件供应，客户本地组装

## 五、跟进时间线

### 第1-2周：A级客户首轮开发
- [ ] 发送首次开发信（10家A级客户）
- [ ] 准备样品（2-3款核心型号各2台）
- [ ] 制作产品对比表（SmartByte vs MikroTik/Zyxel/Ubiquiti）

### 第3-4周：A级跟进 + B级启动
- [ ] A级客户跟进邮件
- [ ] B级客户首次开发信（15家）
- [ ] LinkedIn添加关键决策人

### 第5-8周：样品寄送 + B级跟进
- [ ] 有意向客户寄样
- [ ] B级客户跟进
- [ ] 收集反馈，调整报价/产品配置

### 第9-12周：首单转化
- [ ] 跟进样品测试结果
- [ ] 报价谈判
- [ ] 首批订单确认

## 六、关键成功因素

1. **价格竞争力** — SmartByte FOB价格比MikroTik低30-65%，这是最强武器
2. **L3路由完整性** — BGP4/OSPF/ECMP/VRRP，很多竞品不支持
3. **Marvell芯片背书** — 企业级可靠性，非Realtek/国产芯片
4. **OEM灵活性** — 贴牌/定制固件/SKD/CKD
5. **快速响应** — 样品3天发货，订单2-3周交付
6. **认证齐全** — CE/FCC/UKCA/RoHS/Reach/CCC，全球通行

---

## 七、风险管理

| 风险 | 应对 |
|------|------|
| 客户信任度低（新品牌） | 提供Marvell芯片原厂证明+工厂视频+ISO证书 |
| 付款风险 | 首批T/T 30%预付+70%见提单付款，或信用证 |
| 汇率波动 | 报价有效期30天，锁定汇率 |
| 物流时效 | DHL/FedEx样品(3-5天)，海运大货(15-30天) |
| 售后维护 | 1年质保+远程技术支持+RMA流程 |
